title: Flexible linker modulates the binding affinity of the TP901-1 CI phage repressor to DNA.
authors: Varming, Anders Kokkenborg; Rasmussen, Kim Krighaar; Zong, Zhiyou; Thulstrup, Peter Waaben; Kilstrup, Mogens; Lo Leggio, Leila
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学模拟与SAXS实验，研究噬菌体CI阻遏蛋白柔性linker长度对TF-DNA结合亲和力的调控机制，核心聚焦蛋白-DNA互作与动态构象，方法含MD模拟，高度匹配课题。
abstract: Temperate bacteriophages can switch between two life cycles following infection of a host bacterium: the lytic or lysogenic life cycle. The choice between these is controlled by a bistable genetic switch. We investigated the genetic switch of the lactococcal temperate bacteriophage, TP901-1, which is controlled by two regulatory proteins, the Clear 1 (CI) repressor and modulator of repression (MOR) antirepressor. CI consists of a DNA-binding N-terminal domain and a C-terminal domain responsible for oligomerization, connected by a flexible interdomain linker. Full-length CI is hexameric, whereas the truncated version CI with 58 C-terminal residues truncated (CIDelta58), missing the second C-terminal subdomain, is dimeric, but binds with the same affinity as full-length CI to the O(L) operator site, responsible for lytic genes transcription repression. Three variants of CIDelta58 with shorter, longer, and PP substituted linkers were produced and confirmed by circular dichroism spectroscopy and nanodifferential scanning fluorimetry to be well folded. With small-angle X-ray scattering, we delineated the conformational space sampled by the variants and wild-type in solution and found that shortening and lengthening the linker decrease and increase this, respectively, as also substantiated by molecular dynamics and as intended. Isoelectric focusing electrophoresis confirmed that all variants are able to bind to the MOR antirepressor. However, using electrophoretic mobility shift assays, we showed that shortening and lengthening the linker lead to a 94 and 17 times decrease in affinity to O(L) , respectively. Thus, an appropriate linker length appears to be crucial for appropriate DNA-binding and subsequent TP901-1 genetic switch function.
abstract_zh: 温和噬菌体在感染宿主细菌后可切换两种生命周期：裂解性或溶原性生命周期。二者之间的选择由一双稳态遗传开关控制。我们研究了乳酸菌温和噬菌体TP901-1的遗传开关，该开关由两种调控蛋白——Clear 1（CI）阻遏蛋白和阻遏调节因子（MOR）抗阻遏蛋白——控制。CI由负责DNA结合的N端结构域和负责寡聚化的C端结构域组成，两者通过一个柔性的结构域间连接子相连。全长CI为六聚体，而截短版本CI（缺失C端58个残基的CIDelta58）缺少第二个C端亚结构域，为二聚体，但其与O(L)操纵子位点的结合亲和力与全长CI相同，该位点负责裂解基因转录的抑制。我们生成了三种CIDelta58变体，分别具有更短、更长及脯氨酸（PP）取代的连接子，并通过圆二色光谱和纳米差示扫描荧光法确认其折叠良好。利用小角X射线散射，我们描绘了变体与野生型在溶液中所采样的构象空间，发现缩短和延长连接子分别减少和增加该空间，这亦通过分子动力学模拟得到证实，且符合预期。等电聚焦电泳确认所有变体均能结合MOR抗阻遏蛋白。然而，通过电泳迁移率变动分析，我们显示缩短和延长连接子分别导致对O(L)的亲和力降低94倍和17倍。因此，适当的连接子长度对于正确的DNA结合及后续TP901-1遗传开关功能至关重要。
